_comment: Castellan Farm ACTUAL tariff. plan='custom_tou' uses the explicit peak/mid/off hours and rates below (no seasonal variation). Switch plan to 'tou'/'ulo'/'flat' to use the Ontario RPP fields instead. After editing, re-run prepare_inputs.py.
name: Castellan actual TOU

custom_tou._hours_note: Normal on-peak window 11:00-17:00 (6 h), mid 07:00-11:00 (4 h), off-peak the remaining 14 h. Weekends all off-peak.

_demand_charge_note: Set a $/kW value if the site is on a demand-billed (General Service) tariff to value peak-demand reduction.
